strings.name: Gong Li
strings.summary: Gong Li starred in Red Sorghum while studying at the Central Academy of Drama. The Story of Qiu Ju, Farewell My Concubine and To Live established her portrayals of women in contrasting social circumstances. A Venice acting-prize winner, she also appeared in international productions including Memoirs of a Geisha. Her career connects Chinese auteur cinema with international commercial filmmaking and festival activity.

strings.influence.rationale: Through Red Sorghum and The Story of Qiu Ju, she contributed to Chinese cinema’s international breakthrough and broadened global collaborations for Chinese-language actors.

strings.timeline.t1.title: AI film festival president

strings.timeline.t2.title: Leap
strings.timeline.t2.text: Portrayed Lang Ping in Peter Chan’s film.

strings.timeline.t5.title: Farewell My Concubine
strings.timeline.t5.text: Played Juxian in Chen Kaige’s Palme d’Or-winning film.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Venice acting prize
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won Best Actress for The Story of Qiu Ju.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Drama academy graduation

strings.timeline.t8.title: Film debut
